:::{#exr-derive-bernoulli-score-deviation}
#### Score of a Bernoulli variable in terms of deviation and precision

In the setting of @exr-derive-bernoulli-score,
let $\devn \eqdef x - \E{X}$ be the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) of $x$ from the mean of $X$.
Write the [score](#def-score) using $\devn$ and $\precision$.

:::
